description.content: Get array of document file objects.

query.description: Limits documents to those which have changed since the given timestamp, formatted as a ISO 8601 XSD-timestamp.
List only those files that were created after this date.
List only those files that were created before this date.
Number of files to be shown at once as part of the first page or for every page.

To disable any paging and either return all files or just the first few files as
specified by the limit parameter. This parameter supersedes the page parameter.
Recursively include subdirectories, accepted as values 'true' or 'false'.
(Required) The absolute path of the directory to list files from.
List directory definitions including '.' and subdirectories.
List of file names to look for.
Regex file name patterns to use to search for files.

The state of the document files to show; 'new' for non dispatched, 'failed', for ones
with validation errors, 'dispatched' for dispatched documents, 'dispatch_failed' for
ones where dispatch has failed.
List only those files that have an associated document id.
Page number of the query
